en: A colorized early-20th-century scene of a railway station platform with electric trains and wooden carriages. Tall lamps line the platform on the left, while tracks and trains extend into the distance on the right. Handwritten cursive text covers the lower portion of the card. Printed text in red at the bottom left reads "Stockholm" and at the bottom right "Östra station". There is a small imprint credit at the lower left.
